mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(check_count), 0) AS checkCount, ROUND(AVG(NVL(on_time_rate, 0)), 2) || '%' AS onTimeRate, MAX(wait_time) AS waitTime, MAX(avg_wait_late) AS avgWaitLate, MAX(avg_report_time) AS avgReportTime FROM TR_MEDTECH_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT dept_name AS deptName, NVL(SUM(check_count), 0) AS checkCount, ROUND(AVG(NVL(on_time_rate, 0)), 2) || '%' AS onTimeRate, ROUND(AVG(NVL(wait_time, 0)), 2) AS waitTime, ROUND(AVG(NVL(avg_wait_late, 0)), 2) AS avgWaitLate, ROUND(AVG(NVL(avg_report_time, 0)), 2) AS avgReportTime FROM TR_MEDTECH_DTL m INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON m.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE m.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND d.outp_or_inp IN (0, 2)
AND d.dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND d.dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY checkCount DESC
